name: koda-studio
description: Kotlin & Android development for VS Code, like Android Studio: its own Kotlin language server with completion, navigation, references, errors as you type, Optimize Imports and Reformat Code across Gradle modules.

kodaStudio.gradle.javaHome.markdownDescription: JDK used to run the Gradle sync. Leave empty to use the same JDK as `./gradlew` (`org.gradle.java.home`, then `JAVA_HOME`, then the newest JDK 17+ found on this machine), which lets the sync reuse your existing Gradle daemon.

kodaStudio.gradle.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra Gradle command-line arguments for every sync, for example `-Pfoo=bar`.

kodaStudio.variant.markdownDescription: Build variant of the application modules, for example `prodDebug`. Library modules follow the variant the application consumes. Use **Koda: Select Build Variant** to change it.

enumDescriptions: Also generate R classes, BuildConfig, view/data binding and AIDL (fast, no compilation).
Also run generate<Variant>Sources and KSP/kapt, which compiles upstream modules.
kodaStudio.sync.generateSources.description: Which generated sources a sync produces.

kodaStudio.sync.onGradleFileChange.description: What to do when build.gradle(.kts), settings or the version catalog change.

enumDescriptions: After the first sync of a project (or after Clear Caches), when the Kotlin server indexes everything next and needs the memory.
After every sync. The next sync or build starts a new daemon, which takes longer.
Keep it running for the next sync or build.
kodaStudio.sync.stopGradleDaemon.description: Stop the Gradle daemon a sync started once the sync is done, to free its memory (often 2–4 GB).

kodaStudio.sync.stopDaemonsOnClose.description: When the window or project closes, stop the Gradle and Kotlin daemons that Koda Studio's syncs started. Daemons of your own builds (terminal, Android Studio) are left running.

kodaStudio.librarySources.markdownDescription: Attach library `-sources.jar` files so go to definition opens the real source instead of decompiled code.
enumDescriptions: Each sync downloads the sources jars of all libraries (once; later syncs reuse the Gradle cache).
Only sources jars already in the Gradle cache (downloaded by Android Studio or an earlier sync).
No library sources: go to definition shows decompiled code.

kodaStudio.androidSdkSources.markdownDescription: Attach the Android SDK sources (`<sdk>/sources/android-<api>`, install them with the SDK manager) so go to definition opens framework source. Makes the Kotlin index larger.

kodaStudio.server.javaHome.markdownDescription: JDK 17+ that runs the Kotlin language server. Leave empty to use the same JDK as the Gradle sync.

kodaStudio.server.jvmArgs.markdownDescription: JVM arguments for the Kotlin language server. The default keeps it at about 3.5–4 GB on a large project (a 3 GB heap; idle memory is handed back to the system). A larger `-Xmx` makes big reference searches faster at the cost of memory. Takes effect after **Koda: Restart Kotlin Server**.

kodaStudio.completion.namedArguments.markdownDescription: When completing a Kotlin function, pass its required arguments by name: `Text(text = …)`. Java methods always take positional arguments. Takes effect after **Koda: Restart Kotlin Server**.

enumDescriptions: Before strings, numbers, true/false and null: `Text(text: "Hi")`.
kodaStudio.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Show parameter names before call arguments, as IntelliJ does. Takes effect after **Koda: Restart Kotlin Server**.

kodaStudio.composeStability.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the Compose stability of composable parameters (`stable`, `runtime`, `unstable`) as inlay hints, warn on unstable parameters, and explain it on hover. Takes effect after **Koda: Restart Kotlin Server**.

kodaStudio.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a "N usages" CodeLens above Kotlin declarations.

kodaStudio.codeLens.implementations.description: Also show "N implementations" above interfaces and abstract or open declarations.

kodaStudio.codeLens.maxSymbolsPerFile.description: Skip the usages CodeLens in files with more declarations than this (0: no limit). Only the declarations on screen are searched.

scripts.package: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:lsp && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.test:e2e:tiket: npm run build && node test/e2e/run.mjs ~/Projects/Android/tiketandroid --pass both
scripts.build:lsp: cd lsp && ./gradlew installDist -q && rm -rf ../server/kotlin-lsp && cp -R app/build/install/kotlin-lsp ../server/kotlin-lsp
